changes: Native owns its writable user config; root defaults and complete required provider definitions use immutable per-provider system-v1 generation files.

Only same-path config/requirements binds overlay the worker namespace. Host originals, managed_config and relative reference origins remain intact. Only empty missing root-owned mount targets may be created exclusively.

Strict policy merge rejects global conflicts and native-unreadable host files. Host fingerprints and exact generated bytes are checked by a fixed root oneshot outside worker binds on each worker start.

ChatGPT custom required provider pins the official backend, auth method and WebSocket route. Responses requirements replace the complete provider definition. Credentials are absent from generated TOML.

Operator-only migration/refresh/rollback/recovery journals exact old configuration, units, sudo policy, provider pointers and service activity. Stop uncertainty retains start barriers and recovery materials; user config bytes are never rewritten.
Control rollback rejects incompatible retained capability levels until explicit legacy namespace/sudo downgrade. New installation performs host conflict preflight before creating instance identities.

tests.coverage: Real ownership, permissions, links and relocated files; host preservation/conflicts/drift; migration/rollback, independent service activity, unknown-stop retention, phase/publication crash recovery, native user config preservation, and incompatible control rollback. Service/account operations are substituted.

independentProbes.purpose: Pinned CLI requirements replace provider definitions while native config writes remain writable; supplied by parent.
Fake-credential isolated ChatGPT routing sends responses WebSocket upgrade to required endpoint and no user endpoint; rejected transport, not successful inference.
Parent executed isolated root check/main namespace chain: helper sees HOST on repeated starts, main sees BOUND; host replacement prevents third main startup. Temporary unit cleanup confirmed.

limits: No online instance was migrated or deployed. No full suite, paid inference, personal credentials or external MCP calls.
Transaction fixtures substitute systemd/visudo/account effects; separate parent-run systemd probes establish namespace/check-chain behavior, not complete production migration or reboot acceptance.
Host policy is immutable to native, not to host root. Root administrator changes require explicit refresh and can block recovery/startup.
Legacy downgrade intentionally removes the workspace sudo verb and resumes the old read-only user-config mount while retaining native user bytes.
This is an implementation/test record, not an independent clean full-source audit.
